name: buidl
summary: Brief-to-product pipeline on GitHub Actions: a hackathon or grant brief becomes a repo with a Foundry contract + tests, a live GitHub Pages dApp, CI and a submission pack (description per judging criterion, track mapping, demo script, Marp deck, milestones/budget, compliance), built from Blockchain Lab blocks and verified (CI green, Pages 200).

entrypoints.name: Brief to product
entrypoints.usage: workflow_dispatch inputs: brief_url, brief_text, name, mode; or open a 'Brief' issue

entrypoints.name: python3 -m buidl run
entrypoints.usage: python3 -m buidl run --brief-url <url> [--brief-file f] [--name slug] [--mode auto|create|branch|none]

entrypoints.name: python3 -m buidl promote
entrypoints.usage: python3 -m buidl promote <slug>  # sandbox branch -> Blockchains/<slug>

inputs.name: brief_url / brief_text
inputs.description: ETHGlobal, Devpost, DoraHacks, Gitcoin, grant pages, or pasted text

inputs.name: XAI_API_KEY
inputs.description: Grok (grok-4.7) for parsing, planning, contract and docs

inputs.name: FORGE_TOKEN
inputs.description: optional fine-grained PAT to create repos; without it products go to sandbox branches + Pages here

outputs.name: product repo
outputs.description: contracts/, web/, docs/submission/, COMPLIANCE.md, brief/, CI + Pages, README/AGENTS.md/llms.txt/blocks.json

outputs.name: runs/<slug>-<run>.json
outputs.description: requirements summary, plan, contract attempts, CI/Pages URLs, Grok tokens and USD

compatible_with.how: blocks.json hub used as the planning catalogue
236-fork catalogue with reuse fields used by the planner
Grok/xAI integrations catalogue used by the planner
sibling generator for token/NFT ideas (same publish pattern)
source of open hackathon briefs to feed in

tests.command: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests && python3 -m buidl run --requirements examples/ethonline2026/requirements.json --plan examples/ethonline2026/plan.json --mode none --no-grok
